title: Notice of Public Hearing on Changes to Real Property Tax Exemptions
text: Town of Pound Ridge Office of the Town Clerk townclerk@townofpoundridge.gov 914-764-5549 NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING ON PROPOSED CHANGES TO REAL PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Town Board of the Town of Pound Ridge will hold public hearings on November 4, 2026, commencing at 7:30 pm, or as soon thereafter as time allows, to provide an opportunity for public comment on the following: 1) Changes to real property tax exemptions for veterans with serious disabilities 2) Changes to real property tax exemptions for active duty members of the armed forces 3) Changes to real property tax exemptions for surviving spouses of volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers 4) Changes to real property tax exemptions for surviving spouses of police officers killed in the line of duty. The public may attend the meeting remotely or in person at the Town House. Those wishing to view the meeting remotely may access the video livestream at https://vimeo.com/event/2423847. Those wishing to join the meeting via videoconference must register by 12:00 noon on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Email townclerk@townofpoundridge.gov to receive Zoom information. Erin Trostle, Town Clerk Dated at Pound Ridge, New York October 25, 2026 Town House 179 Westchester Avenue Pound Ridge, New York 10576-1743

Erin Trostle, Town Clerk Dated at Pound Ridge, New York October 28, 2026 TOWN OF POUND RIDGE LOCAL LAW No. 5 of 2026 A LOCAL LAW to grant a partial real property tax exemption for Active Duty Members of the Armed Forces Serving in a Combat Zone BE IT ENACTED by the Town Board of the Town of Pound Ridge as follows: Section 1. Title. This local law shall be known as “A Local Law to Grant a Partial Real Property Tax Exemption for Active Duty Members of the Armed Forces Serving in a Combat Zone” Section 2. Purpose. The purpose of this local law is to grant a partial exemption of the assessed valuation of real property owned as a primary residence by a member of the armed forces serving in a combat zone as set forth by the Real Property Tax Law of the State of New York, §458-d. All terms, definitions, and conditions of such statute shall apply to this local law. Section 3. Exemption Pursuant to §458-d of the Real Property Tax Law, as added by Chapter 677 of the Laws of 2025, qualifying residential real property owned by an active duty military service member whose military duty station is within New York State and who at any time during the taxable year performed active duty in a combat zone shall be exempt from taxation by the Town of Pound Ridge to the extent of twenty-five percent (25%) of the assessed value of such property; provided, however, that such exemption shall not exceed $20,000 or the product of $20,000 multiplied by the latest state equalization rate for the assessing unit, or in the case of a special assessing unit, the latest class ratio, whichever is less. The exemption provided by the section shall not be applicable to taxes levied for school purposes. If an active military service member is currently receiving an exemption under Section 458, 458-a, or 458-b of the Real Property Tax Law in any given taxable year, the active duty service member shall not be eligible to receive the exemption under this section during the same taxable year. Application for exemption shall be made by the owner, or all of the owners, of the property on a form prescribed by the state board. The owner or owners shall file the completed form in the assessor’s office on or before the first appropriate taxable status date, along with documentation of active duty in a combat zone, such as a copy of military orders or a certified letter from the commanding officer. The owner or owners of the property shall be required to refile each year on or before the appropriate taxable status date. Any applicant convicted of willfully making any false statement in the application for such exemption shall be subject to the penalties prescribed in the Penal Law. Section 4. Severability. If any clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law shall be adjudged by and court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, such judgment shall not affect, impair, or invalidate the remainder thereof, but shall be confined in its operation to said clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law. Section 5. Effective Date. This local law shall take effect immediately upon filing in the office of the Secretary of State in accordance with Municipal Home Rule Law §27. TOWN OF POUND RIDGE LOCAL LAW NO. 4 of 2026 A LOCAL LAW to adopt the optional full real property tax exemption for seriously disabled veterans authorized by Real Property Tax Law §458-a(11) BE IT ENACTED by the Town Board of the Town of Pound Ridge as follows: Section 1. Title. This local law shall be known as “A Local Law to Adopt the Optional Full Real Property Tax Exemption for Seriously Disabled Veterans authorized by Real Property Tax Law §458-a(11).” Section 2. Purpose. The purpose of this local law to create an additional alternative veterans exemption for seriously disabled veterans, as set forth by the Real Property Tax Law of the State of New York, §458-a(11). All terms, definitions, and conditions of such statute shall apply to this local law. Section 3. Eligibility. Pursuant to §458-a(11) of the Real Property Tax Law of the State of New York, the veterans eligible to receive the exemption as set forth in that section shall be eligible for same in the Town of Pound Ridge. Section 4. Severability. If any clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law shall be adjudged by and court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, such judgment shall not affect, impair, or invalidate the remainder thereof, but shall be confined in its operation to said clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law. Section 5. Effective Date. This local law shall take effect immediately upon filing in the office of the Secretary of State in accordance with Municipal Home Rule Law §27. TOWN OF POUND RIDGE LOCAL LAW No. 6 of 2026 A LOCAL LAW to grant a partial real property tax exemption for surviving spouses of volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance service members BE IT ENACTED by the Town Board of the Town of Pound Ridge as follows: Section 1. Title. This local law shall be known as “A Local Law to Grant a Partial Real Property Tax Exemption for Surviving Spouses of Volunteer Firefighters and Volunteer Ambulance Service Members.” Section 2. Purpose. The purpose of this local law to provide volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance service members who are qualified real property owners with the tax exemption authorized by §466-a of the Real Property Tax Law and to continue this exemption in the case of certain surviving spouses of deceased volunteers pursuant to that law. The exemptions authorized by this local law are subject to all the qualifications and limitations set forth in §466-a and §466-l of the Real Property Tax Law. Section 3. Exemption Real property owned by the surviving spouse of a deceased member of an incorporated volunteer fire company, fire department, or incorporated voluntary ambulance service killed in the line of duty shall be exempt from taxation to the extent of fifty percent of the assessed value of such property for county purposes and county special district purposes other than sewer purposes, exclusive of special assessments; provided that: A. Such surviving spouse is certified by the authority having jurisdiction for the incorporated volunteer fire company, fire department, or incorporated voluntary ambulance service as surviving spouse of an enrolled member of such incorporated volunteer fire company, fire department, or incorporated voluntary ambulance service who was killed in the line of duty; and B. Such deceased volunteer had been an enrolled member for at least five years; and C. Such deceased volunteer had been receiving an exemption prior to their death. Section 4. Severability. If any clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law shall be adjudged by and court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, such judgment shall not affect, impair, or invalidate the remainder thereof, but shall be confined in its operation to said clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law. Section 5. Effective date. This local law shall take effect immediately upon filing in the office of the Secretary of State in accordance with Municipal Home Rule Law §27. TOWN OF POUND RIDGE LOCAL LAW No. 7 of 2026 A LOCAL LAW to grant a Partial Real Property Tax Exemption for Surviving Spouses of Police Officers Killed in the Line of Duty BE IT ENACTED by the Town Board of the Town of Pound Ridge as follows: Section 1. Title. This local law shall be known as “A Local Law to Grant a Partial Real Property Tax Exemption for Surviving Spouses of Police Officers Killed in the Line of Duty” Section 2. Purpose. The purpose of this local law to grant a partial exemption from taxation of fifty percent (50%) of the assessed valuation of real property that is owned as a primary residence by the surviving spouse of a police officer who is killed in the line of duty subject to the requirements set forth in §471 of the Real Property Tax Law. Section 3. Exemption. Pursuant to Real Property Tax Law §471, the Town of Pound Ridge authorizes an exemption of fifty percent of the assessed value of qualifying real property for the surviving spouse of a police officer killed in the line of duty. Section 4. Eligibility. Such exemption shall not be granted unless: (a) the property is the primary residence of such surviving spouse (b) the conditions of New York State Real Property Tax Law §471 are met. Section 5. Application. Application for such exemption shall be filed with the Assessor on or before the taxable status date on a form as prescribed by New York State. Section 6. Severability. If any clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law shall be adjudged by and court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, such judgment shall not affect, impair, or invalidate the remainder thereof, but shall be confined in its operation to said clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or part of this local law. Section 7. Effective date. This local law shall take effect immediately upon filing in the office of the Secretary of State in accordance with Municipal Home Rule Law §27. Town of Pound Ridge Highway Department MEMO DATE: 10/29/2026 TO: Town Board Members FROM: Joseph J. Capalbo, Highway Superintendent RE: Replacement of Highway Department Vehicle I am requesting the Town Board’s consideration to replace the Highway Department’s 2015 Ford F-250, currently with approximately 82,000 miles, with a 2026 Chevrolet 3500 equipped with a snowplow package and emergency strobe lighting. The total proposed purchase price of the 2026 Chevrolet 3500, including the snowplow package, emergency strobe lighting, and necessary equipment, is $65,684.30. Although the Ford has relatively low mileage, it is now 11 years old. Proactive replacement would help limit the risk of increasing repair costs and unexpected downtime. The Chevrolet 3500 would serve as both the Superintendent’s vehicle and an additional working truck for snow removal, storm response, roadway inspections, and daily Highway Department operations Once replaced, the Ford F-250 would be declared surplus and sold in accordance with Town procedures. I believe this is a practical investment in the Department’s reliability, flexibility, and service to the Town.
